dimensions.assessment: Affects group health plans, health insurance issuers, and health plan participants or beneficiaries subject to utilization review.
dimensions.evidence: A group health plan and a health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage shall ensure that any adverse benefit determination

dimensions.assessment: Prohibits AI systems from solely issuing adverse benefit determinations involving clinical judgment, mandating review by licensed health care professionals.
dimensions.evidence: is not issued by an artificial intelligence system and is not dictated or determined by the output of such system; (2) is made only by a licensed health care professional

dimensions.assessment: Does not explicitly appropriate federal funds or state specific federal budget expenditures.
Amends multiple major federal statutes including the Public Health Service Act, ERISA, and the Internal Revenue Code.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XXVII of the Public Health Service Act, the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to plan years beginning on or after the specified effective date.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall apply to plan years beginning on or after January 1

importance_detail.rationale: Regulates group health plans and issuers regarding the use of artificial intelligence in claims reviews and adverse benefit determinations, requiring human clinical judgment.
